In May this year, OpenAI launched an enterprise-specific version of its mobile application. Now SpaceXAI is also launching a similar version for Grok.

Grok for Intune is now available

This enterprise-specific app is called Grok for Intune. SpaceXAI says this dedicated app is "the Microsoft Intune version of Grok, an AI assistant developed by xAI—designed specifically for organisations using Intune to manage applications and data".

SpaceXAI points out: "It supports Intune mobile application management, complies with organisations' application protection policies, and can be logged in via corporate email."

SpaceXAI lists the following features of Grok for Intune:

AI Assistant: Ask anything and get quick answers, conduct in-depth web research, or tackle tough problems in maths, science and coding. Upload files or photos, or paste links, and let Grok analyse and explain the content for you. Grok Image Generation: Generate stunning images from simple text prompts, or upload images and have Grok edit them—remove objects, transform scenes, or apply any artistic style. Use text prompts combined with audio to create short videos, or turn static photos into videos. Voice Mode: Have a conversation with Grok and get natural, fluent voice responses without using your hands. Live Camera: Share what you see in front of you and let Grok analyse and reason about it in real time. Real-time Information: Grok accesses the web and data from X to ensure you get the latest news, trends and developments on any topic. Built for Managed Devices: Deployed and configured by your IT team through Microsoft Intune. Complies with your organisation's application protection policies, including restrictions on storage, sharing and data transfer. Corporate email sign-in. No in-app purchases.

Grok for Intune is now available on the App Store.
